# v0.8.2 — Plug & Charge no longer blocked by an old release stop

Integration and app **0.8.2**. In service mode, update the app first, then the
integration.

- **Virtual Plug & Charge:** **Charging release** switched off by hand now stops
  only the current connection. Until now it was remembered for good, so every
  later plug-in of the recognized car stayed locked with the blocking reason
  **Charging release switched off**, unseen because the switch shows off while the gate
  is closed anyway. A stop already saved ends at the next unplug or when
  Virtual Plug & Charge is switched on. Without Virtual Plug & Charge, a release
  switched off stays off as before.
